aks-acns-retina-oss-alternative.title: Retina OSS is a free option for basic network observability
aks-acns-retina-oss-alternative.body: Advanced Container Networking Services is billed per node. If the need is essential network monitoring only, the open-source Retina platform that Microsoft also supports is a free alternative; check whether the paid features are needed for all nodes.
